description: This file defines the class CompositeInput within the device namespace, which manages composite video input streams, including methods to get input status, select ports, and scale video. It also includes licensing and documentation comments.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: A class that manages COMPOSITE Input, providing methods to access input status and control input ports.

methods.name: CompositeInput::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the CompositeInput class.

methods.name: CompositeInput::getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of composite inputs available.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isPresented
methods.description: Checks if the composite input is present.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a given port is active.

methods.name: CompositeInput::isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is connected.

methods.name: CompositeInput::scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video input to specified dimensions.
